intro.h2: A Lake Wales cabinet shop that people come back to
paragraphs: Custom By Alvarez has been in business since 1995, installing kitchen cabinets in Lake Wales and showing cabinets, solid surface and countertops at its shop at 18720 US-27. You can stop by the showroom, look at materials and talk the job through face to face.

What reviewers mention most is the people. Chris, Mary and Liz help you choose, and they are patient while you decide. One customer wrote that his brother used them 25 years ago and that kitchen still looks beautiful. Another thanked Luis, who handles the electrical and plumbing portion, so the hookups are done by the same team that sets the cabinets.

about.h2: The people behind Custom By Alvarez
about.text: Custom By Alvarez is a Lake Wales cabinet and countertop shop, with its showroom and yellow work truck based at 18720 US-27. The banner over the shop windows reads cabinets, solid surface, countertops, established 1995. Customers know the team by first name: Chris and Liz walked one couple through their kitchen choices, Mary and Chris gave another customer her new kitchen, and Luis handles the electrical and plumbing portion of the work. The owners reply to their Google reviews and invite customers back to the showroom after the job is done.

image.alt: Custom By Alvarez storefront at 18720 US-27 in Lake Wales with its cabinets, solid surface and countertops banner

process.h2: How a Custom By Alvarez project works

steps.title: Visit or call
steps.text: Call (863) 439-3889 or stop by the US-27 showroom Tuesday to Saturday to talk about your kitchen or bath.

steps.title: Estimate and recommendations
steps.text: The team gives you an estimate, recommends cabinets and tops for your space and gives you the time you need to decide.

steps.title: Design your kitchen
steps.text: Choose the door style, color and countertop with the team, who help you design the kitchen layout.

steps.title: Install and hook up
steps.text: The crew installs the cabinets and countertops, and Luis handles the electrical and plumbing portion, such as hooking up the sink.

steps.title: Enjoy your kitchen
steps.text: You look over the finished kitchen together. Customers say they would use Custom By Alvarez again and recommend them to family and friends.

items.name: Robert O.
items.text:
After several estimate quotes for a new kitchen, my wife and I chose Custom By Alvarez. We compared before and after photos, years in business, warranties and prices. After talking to Chris and Liz, we felt comfortable with their recommendations and their professionalism.We trusted and felt confident with our decision. Thank you Chris and Liz for our beautiful kitchen. We will highly recommend you with confidence to family and friends.

PS,
My brother used them 25 years ago and their kitchen still looks beautiful since the day it was installed.

items.name: Kathy B.
items.text: Great job installing.  I love the look of my new countertops.  Alvarez's patient with you deciding on the countertop & helpful. They were always on time each visit to my home.

items.name: Girl S.
items.text: A big thank you to Mary and Chris for giving me my new kitchen. I love it! I was about to use another company, but I'm so glad I came across Custom by Alvarez. It was definitely worth it. Professional, clean, on time and courteous; I will definitely use them in any future endeavors. Also a special shout out to Luis who handles the electrical and plumbing portion. Thank you for your professionalism and expertise. You are awesome.

service_area.h2: Kitchen cabinets in Lake Wales and nearby
service_area.text: Custom By Alvarez works out of its showroom at 18720 US-27 in Lake Wales, Florida, where you can see cabinets, solid surface and countertops in person. If you live in or around Lake Wales, call (863) 439-3889 to ask whether your address is in range, or drop in Tuesday through Saturday between 9 AM and 5 PM to talk about your kitchen or bath.

items.q: Where is the Custom By Alvarez showroom?
items.a: The shop is at 18720 US-27, Lake Wales, FL 33853. Look for the storefront with the large cabinets, solid surface and countertops banner. The owners encourage customers to stop by the showroom, so you can see cabinet doors and countertop materials in person before you choose.

The showroom is open Tuesday to Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed on Sunday and Monday. Outside those hours, you can call (863) 439-3889 or email cbatops@aol.com with a short note about your kitchen or bath and the best time to reach you.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Cabinets, solid surface and countertops are the core of the business, as the shop banner says. Google reviewers also mention full new kitchens, countertop replacement, bathroom cabinets and sink installation, with the electrical and plumbing portion handled by Luis on the team.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: The Custom By Alvarez banner on the shop reads established 1995. One Google reviewer chose them after comparing years in business, and wrote that his brother used them 25 years ago and that kitchen still looks as beautiful as the day it was installed.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call (863) 439-3889, email cbatops@aol.com or visit the showroom on US-27 during opening hours to talk about your kitchen or bath project. Reviewers describe comparing several estimate quotes and choosing Custom By Alvarez after talking with Chris and Liz about their recommendations.
